Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, it's massive! A humongous boat is the perfect setting for a humongous bust! Hee hee hee! Bust boat!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, technically, it's a ship.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, it's a vacation. A vacation from busting. And tonight, we get to see something that only happens once a decade, the Tri-State Aurora. A natural light show in the sky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A shame there are no pets allowed.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mmm, I know. But it was sweet of Stacy to pet-sit.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Eat my pixels, Teal-Boy!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters triumphantly)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Lucky shot.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, pack your pool noodles and get to the Danville docks. Doof's boarded a party cruise and my Aunt Olga is on that ship celebrating her birthday. I don't want him to ruin her big day. Stop Doof.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Don't worry. I'll cover for you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But I'm not giving back this petsitting money.

Name: Captain
Dialog: (over loudspeaker, with Scandinavian accent) Velcome aboard, passengers. I'm your captain, Sven Jorgansenson. Come sundown, hit the upper deck and witness the majestic beauty of the Tri-State Aurora. Weather permitting, of course.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, thanks for coming with me on this cruise. I... I've been needing a break from evil. It's so much more than a job. It's a lifestyle. That you can take anywhere. So behold! (unzips his fanny pack) My travel-size-inator!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Isn't that the garage door clicker?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yes, but... but I souped it up. It's now my travel-size-inator, and it will shrink anything I want dow to travel-size so it will fit in my bag. And then when I get home, I just reverse it and voila!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So your idea of a break from evil is to steal everything on the ship?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not stealing. This cruise was advertised as "all-inclusive", so I'm getting my money's worth.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, have fun with that. I'm gonna go check out the ship while there's still stuff let to see on it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, not for long, sweetie. Have fun!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mini TV, mini mini-fridge. Ooh, it's so much cuter when it's mini-mini!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You boys have fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing, Mom.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (looking at a brochure) Absolutely splendid. I'll take a deep dive into the history of this ship and—Ooh!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh! Oh my! Oh! (joins the conga line) We'll meet back here tonight for the Aurora!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Forget the boys, Candace. We're on vacation. Let's head to the spa. That'll help you, I mean us, unwind.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmmm. We're out of our natural habitat, Ferb. And I know what we're gonna do today! (rips off his clothes revealing his bathing suit and snorkeling gear) Antiquated spherical artilleryyyyy!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (rips off his clothes also revealing his board shorts and snorkeling gear) Cannonball!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure, if ya wanna say it the easy way. (to two kids making a fort out of building blocks) Cool castle!

Name: Boy
Dialog: Yeah, this is fun, but there's only so much we can do with these blocks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can help with that. Ferb, did you pack those miniature medieval catapults?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll take that. There ya go. (shrinks an umbrella) I'll take that! Just getting my money's worth! And, ooh, that would look nice in my foyer!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters angrily)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! How nice of you to join our little family vac—

Name: Aunt Olga
Dialog: Ow, my toe!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Captain
Dialog: (over loudspeaker) Attention, passengers, due to unexpected cloud cover, tonight's Aurora might be obstructed from view. Let us hope for a change in the weather.

Name: Passenger 1
Dialog: What?

Name: Passenger 2
Dialog: Bummer.

Name: Passenger 3
Dialog: Come on.

Name: Passenger 4
Dialog: Well, looks like it's time to head back into the windowless casino and lose all sense of time and spatial awareness.

Name: Boy
Dialog: Thanks, Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you're welcome. But with those clouds, no one will be able to see the Aurora. Well, Ferb, I now what else we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: My busting senses are tingling.

Name: Masseuse
Dialog: Oh, that's just the massage oil, honey. Relax.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oof! Ow! Okay, okay! I'm relaxing!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Monty
Dialog: Vanessa Doofenshmirtz? Is that you?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Monty Monogram?

Name: Monty
Dialog: What are the odds? Wow! It's been a while. Oh, uh, please allow me to introduce you to Olga, my dad's vaguely European aunt.

Name: Aunt Olga
Dialog: You, nice young girl, take stroll, eat food with nephew. I must soak foot.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Okay, Auntie. I'll see you later. (to Vanessa) Shall we?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: We shall.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? Aah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now I've got potato salad in my pants! Again!

Name: Monty
Dialog: It's crazy us bumping into each other like this. But I'm glad we did.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is that Vanessa?! (babbles incoherently)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ooh, mini corn dogs!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, while a subatomic deionization ray could dissipate the cloud cover, it might be simpler to raise the ship above the clouds. But how?

Name: Clown 1
Dialog: Just look at us, Eddie. We've already run out of kids to make the balloon animals for. What are we gonna do with the rest of this helium?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, we're gonna need bigger balloons!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out! It's working!

Name: Monty
Dialog: So, Nessa, I gotta ask, what happened between us? You kinda just stopped calling.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't know. The whole star-crossed-love thing was fun and all, but I just couldn't keep lying to my dad about us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait! Star-crossed-love? Wait! Wait! Vanessa, was this your secret boyfriend?! This guy?! The guy with the enormous nostrils?! (to Monty) Hey, you've got a bat in the cave there, buddy!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well, the rules are different. We're in international waters.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz Wa-wa-wait! No, no, no! I'm not on the menu!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Did you hear something?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Probably my stomach. I'm starving.

Name: Monty
Dialog: (coughs, and spits the potato salad into his napkin) Sorry, didn't agree with me. Well, that was smooth, huh? Unlike these potatoes. Um, I'm gonna need another napkin.

Name: Busboy
Dialog: Right away, sir. "Work on a cruise ship," they said. "You'll see the world," they said. "You won't just be picking up random people's soiled napkins," they said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys, check out the Aurora! Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Hey! Let us go, you sky rat!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah! Thank you!

Name: Aunt Olga
Dialog: Zzzzzzzz...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, thank goodness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you're okay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But not for long... En garde!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Way to go, Ferb! We did it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, did what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Phineas and Ferb! That's absolutely beautiful. And absolutely bustable! (returns to the spa) Mom, the boys tied massive circus balloon animals to the ship and we're flying through the sky!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (takes off her cucumber slices) Candace, do you even hear the words that come out of your mouth? (puts back on the cucumber slices) You need to relax, honey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Cucumbers can wait! (drags her mother off the chair) Must! Show! Proof!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Hey, wait! How does this toy castle have working catapults?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm not sure we're allowed to run on the deck, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Mom! There are huge balloon animals and they're making us fly!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Mom, quick!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Magnificent! Thanks for making sure I didn't miss it, dear. A perfect end to our mother-daughter day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but but... (sighs) Oh, never mind. It really is beautiful.

Name: Captain
Dialog: (over loudspeaker) Vell, passengers, I am happy to announce the clouds have parted. Take a look at the magic of the Tri-State Aurora.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, hold your tiny horses! I just remembered. My inator had a reverse switch this whole time! I dunno what I was thinking.

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: Freeze!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? It said it was all-inclusive in the brochure.

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: Oh, it is.

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: (apprehending Perry) We're arresting you for smuggling a platypus on board!

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: No pets allowed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's not my pet! We have a complicated relationship.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wow! I'd say something really sweet and clever right now, but I got nothin'.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Me neither.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Eh, we're in international waters.

Name: Busboy
Dialog: I guess it is pretty amazing.

Name: Busboy
Dialog: Fine. (takes dirty napkin)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Truly marvelous.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You should have seen it up close.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's so beautiful! How is it so beautiful?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: The scope of possibilities in this world is as vast as the ocean, and is as limitless as the cosmos.

Name: Clown 2
Dialog: See, Earl? (sucks some helium) This makes all those clown college student loans worth it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Perry the Platypus, it looks like ano— Wai—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus. And curse you, too, you awe-inspiring natural phenomenon.
